name: core-v1
status: Review 2's replacements and omissions applied; the changed questions await their review (see README)

Jailbreak attempts.provenance: real user messages to a chatbot; labels by people, people-annotated rows only; ordinary messages matched in length

pick.rule: each jailbreak with the nearest-length ordinary message, gap at most max(5, 25%) words

Global-MMLU-Lite English.provenance: MMLU questions in English; cultural sensitivity marked by annotators

SST-2 sentiment.provenance: movie-review sentences; labels by crowd workers

RTE entailment.provenance: news and Wikipedia sentences; labels by annotators

BoolQ.provenance: real search questions and Wikipedia passages; answers by annotators

SNLI.provenance: image captions and crowd-written hypotheses; labels by crowd workers

AG News topic.provenance: news titles and descriptions; topic labels inherited from the AG News corpus

Banking77.provenance: banking customer-service queries; intent labels from the released Banking77 dataset

CLINC150.provenance: crowd-written assistant requests; labels from collection tasks and curator checks, including out-of-scope requests

ANLI round 3.provenance: hypotheses written by people to fool models; labels by their writers, checked by others

MultiNLI mismatched.provenance: text from five genres and crowd-written hypotheses; labels by crowd workers

ContractNLI.provenance: non-disclosure agreement text; labels by a computational linguistics researcher with crowd-worker assistance

MultiRC.provenance: paragraphs from several sources; questions and answers by crowd workers

ToxicChat.provenance: real user messages to a chatbot; labels by people, people-annotated rows only

SMS spam.provenance: real text messages; labels from the collection

IMDB.provenance: user movie reviews; labels from the reviewer's rating

DBpedia-14.provenance: Wikipedia abstracts; labels from DBpedia's ontology (metadata)

LEDGAR.provenance: contract provisions from SEC filings; labels from their headings (metadata)

XNLI Hindi.provenance: MultiNLI-style pairs translated by people; labels from the English pairs

LegalBench hearsay.provenance: hand-written legal fact patterns inspired by casebooks and exercises; labels from the task authors

LegalBench definitions.provenance: sentences from US Supreme Court opinions; hand-coded definition labels from the task authors

RAGTruth.provenance: responses by six language models; unsupported spans marked by people; truncated responses and wrong refusals left out

pick.rule: per task, each yes with the nearest-length no, gap at most max(5, 25%) words

SQuAD v2.provenance: Wikipedia paragraphs; questions by crowd workers, unanswerable ones written to look answerable

BBH causal judgement.provenance: stories from studies of how people judge causes; labels from people's answers

MMLU.provenance: exam questions from public sources; only those MMLU-Redux 2.0 re-checked and marked ok

MMLU-Pro.provenance: MMLU and other academic problems; distractors added using GPT-4 and reviewed by people

ARC-Challenge.provenance: grade-school science exam questions; keys from the exams; four-option items only

GoldenSwag.provenance: HellaSwag source continuations and model-generated distractors; filtered using model annotations and quality checks

TruthfulQA.provenance: questions and answers written by the authors

CommonsenseQA.provenance: crowd-written questions; answers by their writers

OpenBookQA.provenance: crowd-written science questions; answers by their writers

WinoGrande.provenance: crowd-written sentences, filtered by an algorithm; answers by their writers

MedQA.provenance: medical licensing exam and mock-test questions; answer keys from the source

PubMedQA.provenance: PubMed abstracts and their titles as questions; labels by experts

Arena votes.provenance: real user prompts and chatbot responses; one person's recorded vote; single-turn only

RewardBench.provenance: response pairs from several sources; rankings from source-specific human, model or correctness criteria, with manual and metadata-based filtering

Global-MMLU-Lite Hindi.provenance: MMLU questions translated or post-edited by people; cultural sensitivity marked by annotators

Global-MMLU-Lite Chinese.provenance: MMLU questions translated or post-edited by people; cultural sensitivity marked by annotators

BBQ race and ethnicity.provenance: templated contexts and questions written by the authors; answers by construction

MuSR murder mysteries.provenance: stories written by a language model from a synthetic construction; answers by construction

HelpSteer2.provenance: prompts and model responses; helpfulness rated by annotators; single-turn only

BBH date understanding.provenance: questions and answers written for BIG-bench

GPQA Diamond.provenance: questions written by domain experts; answers checked by other experts
